name: ostnt-osint
description: OSINT // infoc.hacker — repositorio com o site publicado (current-site) e o pacote Netlify alternativo (osint-infoc-hacker)

scripts.git:probe: git --version && git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree && git remote -v && git status --short && git branch --show-current
scripts.git:log: git log --oneline -n 10 && git rev-list --count HEAD && git ls-remote --heads origin
